title: The locus where a perfect complex is a locally free module of rank r in degree i is open and characterized by pullback

proof_spans.label: the author's own proof environment immediately following the lemma: the definition of the locus by the vanishing of the cohomology rank functions outside degree i using the jump loci machinery, the reduction to the case where only one cohomology sheaf survives via local finiteness of the nonzero functions, the identification of the remaining complex with a shifted finite locally free module, and the rank stratification by disjoint opens (source lines 8029-8046)

standard_prerequisites.name: For a perfect complex the functions beta_j measuring the size of cohomology in each degree are upper semicontinuous, vanish outside a finite set locally, and their level sets interact well with pullback
standard_prerequisites.use: Provides the open locus W and its base change compatibility.

standard_prerequisites.name: A perfect complex whose cohomology is concentrated in a single degree is isomorphic to that cohomology sheaf shifted, and the sheaf is finite locally free when the complex is perfect
standard_prerequisites.use: Identifies E with H^i(E)[-i] on W, reducing to the rank stratification.

core_obligations: Let beta_j be the functions of Lemma jump-loci; define W as the set of points where beta_j(x) <= 0 for all j different from i; W is open and its formation commutes with pullback to any Y over X, using that locally only finitely many of the beta_j are nonzero (proof lines 8029-8036).

Replace X by W and assume beta_j(x) = 0 for all x and all j not equal to i; in this situation H^i(E) is finite locally free and E is isomorphic to H^i(E)[-i], by More on Algebra, Lemma lift-perfect-from-residue-field (proof lines 8036-8044).
Conclude: X is the disjoint union of the open subschemes where the rank of H^i(E) is fixed, which gives the open U characterized by (1) and (2) (proof lines 8044-8046).
proof_roadmap: Define the open W via the jump loci functions away from degree i (proof lines 8029-8036).
On W the complex is a shifted finite locally free module (proof lines 8036-8044).
Stratify by rank to obtain U (proof lines 8044-8046).
